info.title: elekto-mcp-sql
info.description:
Read-only MCP server for SQL Server 2022+ introspection and querying.
      Exposes schema metadata, DDL definitions, dependency graphs, index health diagnostics,
      data profiling and data queries via the Model Context Protocol (stdio transport),
      enabling AI assistants such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to understand your database
      structure without storing credentials in the repository.
      Zero-config for .NET projects: automatically reads ConnectionStrings from
      appsettings.json, web.config and App.config.
